notes: custom_only — no public pricing page despite being the industry's loudest outcome-pricing advocate (Bret Taylor: 'the whole market is going to go towards outcomes-based pricing'). Framing: human call costs $10–20, Sierra prices as a share of the saving. Contracts reportedly blend volume-based pricing for routine interactions with per-resolution for complex ones. $350M raise at $10B valuation (2025). All dollar figures reported-only, never confirmed by Sierra.

plans.name: Custom
plans.billing_unit: per resolution (reported $1–$2.50), blended with volume-based components
plans.whats_gated: Annual contracts reportedly ~$150k+ minimum; year-one totals $200k–$350k+ incl. implementation (up to ~$200k)

outcome_pricing.outcome_definition: Conversation resolved without human escalation; escalated/unresolved interactions generally carry no outcome fee

predictability.refund_on_failure_policy: no outcome fee on unresolved (by model design, reported)
